candidates.name: Viral Myocarditis
support_spans: high-sensitivity cardiac troponin: 128.00 pg/ml initially, peaked at 142.00 pg/ml

candidates.why: The patient's elevated troponin and decreased left ventricular function suggest myocardial involvement, although the negative viral serologies are contradictory.

candidates.protected_reason: This diagnosis may be easily missed due to the focus on the patient's more acute symptoms, such as chest pain and fever.
